lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: We estimate that in 2026 approximately 90 percent of our projected metal container sales and a majority of our projected dispensing and specialty closures and custom container sales will be under multi-year customer supply arrangements.
We estimate that approximately 90 percent of our projected metal container sales in 2026 will be pursuant to multi-year customer supply arrangements.
No other customer accounted for more than 10 percent of our total consolidated net sales during those years.
Our international operations generated approximately $2.09 billion, or approximately 32 percent, of our consolidated net sales in 2025.
Approximately 16 percent of our annual net sales for each of the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 were subject to customer-based SCF arrangements.

Aggregate revenues from our two largest customers (Nestlé S.A. and Campbell Soup Company) accounted for approximately 20.4 percent, 20.3 percent and 19.8 percent of our net sales in 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
Sales of our metal containers segment to Nestlé S.A. accounted for 12.3 percent, 11.6 percent and 11.2 percent of our consolidated net sales in 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
Income before interest and income taxes margin (EBIT margin) | 12.7% | 8.5% | 8.4%
Adjusted EBIT margin | 14.1% | 12.5% | 10.1%

We are also a leading manufacturer and supplier of metal containers in North America and Europe, and in North America we are the largest manufacturer of metal food containers with a unit volume market share in the United States in 2025 of more than half of the market.

We are a leading manufacturer and supplier of metal containers in North America and Europe, and in North America we are the largest manufacturer of metal food containers with a unit volume market share in the United States in 2025 of more than half of the market.
Our thermoformed bowls, trays and tubs are manufactured by melting pellets of resin into an extruded sheet.
Custom containers sold to distributors are generally manufactured by using generic and custom molds with decoration added to meet the end users’ requirements.

We rely on a combination of patents, trade secrets, unpatented know-how, technological innovation, trademarks and other intellectual property rights, nondisclosure agreements and other protective measures to protect our intellectual property.

Economic conditions and disruptions in the credit markets and in markets generally could also harm the liquidity or financial position of our customers or suppliers, which could in turn cause such parties to fail to meet their contractual or other obligations to us or reduce our customers’ purchases from us or our suppliers' supply to us, or result in any customer or supplier declaring bankruptcy, any of which could negatively affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.
